acceptanceCriteria: Decode accepts a plan above 1,000 entries up to a documented scaled bound and refuses beyond it, with tests at both sides.
The spec and --help state the bound.
body:
Observed: the taskman decode limit refuses plans with more than 1,000 entries, which scales poorly for large queues. Expected: the limit scales per entry, as wire.MaxResultNodes does, or is raised with a bound derived from input size.

Source: batch 4 lanes for GitHub #641-#647, 2026-10-06 (branches claude/v1-0645-audit-outside-lock, claude/scale-tasks-v1-0893, claude/scale-core-v1-0416, claude/gh644-live-upgrade). Darwin 25.6.0, go1.27.1. Versions: corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202; corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360).
